findings.title: The frozen corpus and tension scan are targeted rather than systematic or exhaustive
findings.impact: The packet supports scoped design constraints among reviewed candidates; it does not establish global novelty, exhaustive contradiction coverage, external validity, empirical robustness, or superiority.

findings.title: Deterministic byte replay does not make semantic judgments or scientific truth byte-reproducible
findings.impact: The packet proves exact frozen bytes, joins, counts, ordering, and root semantics. It does not certify source truth, semantic extraction completeness, independent model errors, or identical hostile-reviewer judgments on rerun.
